youtube_description:
Jesus... everyone's booking tickets home for Diwali. Why am I pretending I like the quiet? 🪔

He is staying back this Diwali while everyone goes home. The PG is emptying and he keeps telling everyone he likes the quiet.

He: Jesus... everyone's booking tickets home for Diwali. Why am I pretending I like the quiet? 🪔

He: My PG is almost empty already. First Diwali away from home.

Jesus: You said you like the quiet. You refreshed your train app four times today.

He: Flights cost too much this month. Amma would sell her earrings to fix that.

Jesus: She doesn't want your money spent on guilt. She wants your voice on the phone.

He: So I tell her I'm not coming? That's one hard phone call.

Jesus: Make it. She'll pray louder for you than any lamp will glow this year.

He: But what's Diwali in an empty room with nobody's doorway open?

Jesus: Light one lamp where you are. A festival doesn't need a full house to be real.

Jesus: You are the light of the world. Even a city of one needs its light tonight.

Jesus: You are the light of the world. Even a city of one needs its light tonight.

“You are the light of the world. A city on a hill cannot be hidden.”
Matthew 5:14 (BSB)
